brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Seamline, the open-source command-line tool in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: precise, trustworthy, developer-native; it must work in a terminal-heavy README, as a GitHub avatar and on a small docs site. No database cylinders, no elephants, no generic terminal prompt. Web and GitHub only.

claim.notes: Üç yönden ikisi eskiz incelemesinde elendi; Overlap iki tur eleştiride kapıyı geçemedi (5,46 ve 5,92 < 6,5), bu yüzden finalize, export ve gallery çalıştırılmadı.

concepts.title: Overlap
readsAs: tilted H / I-beam on its side
two slanted bars with a connector (equals or Z-like list glyph)
a generic UI list or text-align icon
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 teal tile with an amber slash (disabled / no-symbol, the cut device); s2 pill inside two rounded blocks (toggle, button, UI control); s4 a square spiral loop with an amber lap (rectangular G or 9, meander). s4 is the only one that is not a UI icon or a cut and it survives 16px. Keep: single square-cornered stroke, amber only on the overlap. Fix: make sure the tail-inside-head reads as continuity rather than a G or 9; keep the stroke weight heavy and the gap exact; avoid reading as a maze. Distinct from pgroll.

concepts.title: Joined S
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 blocky S or 5; s2 S or 5 with a notch; s3 S app-icon sticker; s4 S or dollar sign from half-rings. Every sketch is the name's initial with a cut, split or offset, the most common monogram device, and s3 is a sticker. Try a non-letter form, e.g. a seam line where two states meet while traffic flows, and let the S appear only as a consequence.

concepts.title: Running Stitch
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 two orange panels with a pill (toggle / UI control / sofa); s2 circle with a bar (no-entry, minus-in-circle, pizza); s3 square cut on a diagonal (the generic split-square, the cut device); s4 broken fragments, an S or a pipe, illegible at 16px. Thread idea never reads; every form is a cut, a UI icon or a stock circle+bar. Direction dropped.
